crossRefs.note: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper…
But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers…
But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat, and…

translations.web: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
translations.bsb: He will suck the poison of cobras; the fangs of a viper will kill him.
